_about: Every picture in the First Exhibition prototype. itemId is a LOCAL item id (Ben's dev database): k < 1000 came from ~/Dev/ambit-questionnaire/.cache/img, k >= 1000 from ~/Dev/ambit/.cache/img. Captions and tags were assigned by eye in the prototype, not read from the database. `bun run scripts/first-exhibition-faces.ts` turns these ids into (source, sourceId) hand picks.
